caption:
750 deaths since March. A measles outbreak is claiming lives across Bangladesh.

According to a regular report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), three more people died from measles symptoms within 24 hours, from Thursday morning to Friday morning.

Since March 15, a total of 750 people have died from measles and measles-like symptoms across the country.

Of these deaths, 93 were confirmed cases of measles, while 657 people died with measles-like symptoms.

In the last 24 hours, 128 people were confirmed to have measles and 901 others showed symptoms of the disease.

Since March 15, 13,326 people have been confirmed to have measles and 13,09899 people have been identified with measles-like symptoms.

A total of 92,832 people with measles symptoms have been admitted to hospitals since March 15, of which 89,234 have been discharged.

// a total of 109,899 people showing symptoms of measles have been identified since March 15.

headline_marked: 5 [[arrested for killing elderly woman]] in Narsingdi robbery
headline: 5 arrested for killing elderly woman in Narsingdi robbery
summary: The victim, 80-year-old Bobi Begum, was brutally beaten by assailants who stole Tk 40,000 from her room at Methikanda Railway Station.
details: A joint team of the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB), Detective Branch (DB), and Railway Police arrested five people in connection with the killing of 80-year-old Bobi Begum.
The arrests were made during overnight raids in Narsingdi and Brahmanbaria following a brutal assault and robbery at Methikanda Railway Station in Raipura upazila.
On July 5, 2026, assailants broke into the victim's room around 2:00 am and demanded her savings. When she refused, they beat her mercilessly before stealing approximately Tk 40,000.
Bobi Begum was rescued by locals and admitted to Raipura Upazila Health Complex. She later died on July 8 while being transferred to Narsingdi Sadar Hospital.
The incident sparked widespread outrage and social media attention, prompting local administration and political leaders to provide support for her treatment.
The Raipura Upazila Nirbahi Officer (UNO) confirmed that a case was filed with Raipura Police Station on the night of July 6, 2026.
caption:
An 80-year-old woman was beaten to death for Tk 40,000. Now, five suspects have been arrested.

A joint team of the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB), Detective Branch (DB), and Railway Police arrested five people in connection with the killing of 80-year-old Bobi Begum.

The arrests were made during overnight raids in Narsingdi and Brahmanbaria following a brutal assault and robbery at Methikanda Railway Station in Raipura upazila.

On July 5, 2026, assailants broke into the victim's room around 2:00 am and demanded her savings. When she refused, they beat her mercilessly before stealing approximately Tk 40,000.

Bobi Begum was rescued by locals and admitted to Raipura Upazila Health Complex. She later died on July 8 while being transferred to Narsingdi Sadar Hospital.

The incident sparked widespread outrage and social media attention, prompting local administration and political leaders to provide support for her treatment.

The Raipura Upazila Nirbahi Officer (UNO) confirmed that a case was filed with Raipura Police Station on the night of July 6, 2026.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo
